unit: Energy-controlled local capacity convergence and truncated canonical measure limits

Exact earlier continuous density in Lp, bounded recursive product symmetry, strict maximum locality, compact-support integration by parts, CLN, shifted comparison, quasi-continuous level/outer-capacity and bounded capacity continuity interfaces consulted. Earlier verification evidence retained.
source_locators_checked: Exact retained Dinew0705.0974v1 Theorem2.3 p.5 statement and attribution directly checked in the current continuation, with the original image inspected. Its quoted stability proof is not imported. Source normalization remains (4pi)^n times ours at fixed potentials.

proof_scope: Compact-support polynomial-current identity preserves truncation mass; strict maximum locality handles complement and full tie/deep set; all-p truncation energies, total variation and capacity modulus; bounded-subsolution tails and fixed-measure truncations give uniform capacity tails of approximants and the canonical limit; strict shifted comparison plus absolute self-integral error, Hartogs upper difference and quasi-continuous level conversion give local outer-capacity convergence; bounded-product continuity and continuous density in the finite sum measure give finite-mass truncated limits and the global total variation bound. n>=1, zero energies/measure, ties, poles, and unspecified limit boundary trace retained. No unbounded product or limiting equation asserted.

All451 pages rendered against the second build; all three changed images161–163 inspected. Pixel-identical first pages retain visual review.
